# Programs Six intern roles described on the club's board, plus full-time seasonal fellowships for college seniors and recent graduates


*Last updated: November 2026*


No St. Louis Cardinals internship is open as of 13 November 2026: the club's[job board](https://stlcardinals.aaimtrack.com/jobs/) lists two jobs, and neither is for students. The last cycle covered the 2026 season. The club's own description of its Special Events internship says it ran from March 2026 to August 2026, and the Publications Vendor role covered home games from April through at least mid-August in 2025. Those postings are no longer on the board, and we couldn't find a first-party source dating when they opened or closed. In plain words: you apply before the 2027 season starts, and you intern during spring and summer 2027. Because the 2026 open date isn't published, we won't name a month. Set a job alert now so the postings reach you the day they go up.


---


## What Is a St. Louis Cardinals Internship?


A St. Louis Cardinals internship is a part-time, season-long student role with the MLB club's business or baseball operations at Busch Stadium, posted on the club's own ApplicantPro board. It's not the Arizona Cardinals (an NFL team) and not the MLB league office program. The club keeps descriptions for six intern roles: Special Events, Ticket Sales, Publications, Publications Vendor, Cardinals Care/Community Relations and Baseball Operations Draft Intern. Separately, the club hires full-time seasonal fellows (Minor League Affiliate Fellow, Major League Strategy Fellow) for college seniors and recent graduates. The franchise took the Cardinals name in 1900 and has won 11 World Series, per its jobs page, and its Special Events team runs more than 400 events and photo sessions a year.


## When Do St. Louis Cardinals Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


The Cardinals hire interns by season, not on a fixed recruiting calendar. The 2026 Special Events internship ran March 2026 to August 2026, and the 2025 Publications Vendor role worked home games from April through at least mid-August, so the intern postings for each season have to go up and close before spring. We couldn't find a first-party source for the date the 2026 intern postings opened, so this page doesn't project a month for 2027. Fellowships are different and well dated: the club posted them between 30 September and 30 October 2026 for the 2027 season, and in October of 2024 and 2025 for the seasons before. Those are closed.

The company's official careers page is always the most current source. If a role is posted there, go by that, even if this page suggests the window hasn't opened yet.*


### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


Every posting on the Cardinals' board has its own closing date, and recent ones haven't stayed open long. The 2027 Minor League Affiliate Fellow ran from 30 September to 14 October 2026, the Major League Strategy Fellow from 16 to 30 October 2026, and the two jobs open today have 14-day windows. We couldn't read the windows of past intern postings, so assume the same pattern: a couple of weeks, then gone. The job alert is your only reliable signal, so set it up now and have your materials finished before the 2027 postings appear.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


The club's own role descriptions set these requirements. They come from the descriptions on the board today, so read the 2027 posting itself when it opens:


• **Enrollment:** current enrollment at an accredited college or university for every intern role.


• **Class year:** junior standing or above for Special Events, Ticket Sales, Publications and Publications Vendor; sophomore or above for Community Relations; undergraduate or graduate for the Draft Intern.


• **Majors:** Special Events asks for hospitality, business, marketing, PR or communications; the Publications roles name sports business management, PR, marketing, communications or business.


• **GPA, work authorization and sponsorship:** not published on the club's own pages.


• **Schedule:** nights, weekends and holidays as scheduled, and on site at Busch Stadium in St. Louis.


### Can Freshmen and Sophomores Apply?


Mostly not. Four of the six intern descriptions require junior standing, so first- and second-year students should aim at the Community Relations role, which takes sophomores, or use this year to build experience. Fellowships are for college seniors and recent graduates, not underclassmen.

## What Skills Do the St. Louis Cardinals Look For, and How Do You Build Them?


The club's six intern descriptions repeat three themes. **Customer service and sales:** Ticket Sales asks for "Strong customer service skills", and Publications Vendor interns build "hands-on sales and marketing experience" selling at the gates. **Communication and tools:** "Superior written and verbal communication skills" (Ticket Sales) and "Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite including Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook" (Special Events). **Availability:** "Ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays as scheduled". Ticket Sales also prefers knowledge of the Ticket.com ProVenue ticketing platform.

## What Is the St. Louis Cardinals Application and Interview Process Like?


The club doesn't publish an intern interview format. Here's how to be ready:


1. **Set up the alert now.** Use "Sign Up For Job Alerts!" on the club's ApplicantPro board and check it weekly through the winter.


2. **Pick a role you qualify for.** Most intern roles need junior standing; Community Relations takes sophomores.


3. **Prepare before the postings.** Have a one-page résumé and a short cover note naming the role and your game-day availability.


4. **Apply inside the window.** Each posting shows a closing date, and recent ones were open about two weeks.


5. **Interviews.** Steps and timing aren't published; expect the club to contact you after review.


### What Students on Reddit Say


We found no first-hand Reddit accounts of a Cardinals internship. The one thread about the program, from 2023, drew two short replies and no reports from past interns; the others we read were about full-time front-office and sales jobs.


## How Do You Stand Out for a Cardinals Internship?


Three moves. First, show customer-facing experience: the Publications roles ask for prior retail or customer service work, and every sales role leans on it. Second, prove your schedule fits, since the club asks for nights, weekends and holidays, and the vendor role needs 90 percent of home games. Third, bring something you've analyzed or sold, because vendor interns end the season by presenting a performance analysis. The club doesn't publish a class size or a conversion rate, so treat the internship as experience, not a guaranteed job.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 St. Louis Cardinals internship?


No. The 2026 season internships are over, and no Cardinals internship is open as of 13 November 2026. The 2027 season fellowships also closed in October 2026. The next door is the 2027 season: intern postings should go up before spring, but the 2026 open date isn't published, so set a job alert now.


### When do Cardinals internship applications open for 2027?


The date isn't published. The 2026 Special Events internship started in March 2026, so 2027 postings should appear before the season, but we couldn't find a first-party record of when the 2026 postings opened. Turn on job alerts on the club's ApplicantPro board and check it through the winter.


### Are St. Louis Cardinals internships paid?


Pay isn't published on the Cardinals' own pages. The club's intern role descriptions don't list a rate, and we won't repeat third-party estimates. When the 2027 postings appear, check each one for pay and hours before you apply. Fellowships are full-time, salaried roles with benefits, per the club's postings.


### Who can apply for a Cardinals internship?


Current college students. Special Events, Ticket Sales, Publications and Publications Vendor need junior standing or above; Community Relations takes sophomores; the Draft Intern is open to undergraduate and graduate students. Roles are on site at Busch Stadium and need nights, weekends and holidays. GPA and work authorization rules aren't published.


### What is the Cardinals fellowship program?


Fellowships are full-time, salaried seasonal roles for college seniors and recent graduates. For the 2027 season the club posted a Minor League Affiliate Fellow from 30 September to 14 October 2026 and a Major League Strategy Fellow from 16 to 30 October 2026. Both are closed; the next round is expected around October 2027.


### How long does a Cardinals internship last?


Most run the length of the season, part-time. The Special Events internship ran from March 2026 to August 2026 at 12 to 17 hours a week. The Publications Vendor role covered at least 90 percent of home games from April through at least mid-August in 2025, about four hours a game.


No Cardinals internship is open now, and the 2027 season postings will come before spring. If you want a finished project to show by then, a[remote Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships) takes about 5 to 10 hours a week.
